effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Knightmon] text Digimon are played or deleted, by placing 1 such card from your hand or trash under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[Main] [Once Per Turn] If this Tamer has 3 or more [Knightmon] text cards under it, it may digivolve into [LordKnightmon] in the hand or trash for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring digivolution requirements.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
